news.headline: Nektar's Damages Expert Tells Jury Eli Lilly Could Owe Nearly $1 Billion Over Rezpeg Deal
news.summary: In the second week of the San Francisco federal trial (which opened September 8), Nektar's damages expert testified that Eli Lilly could owe close to $1 billion in lost milestone and royalty value if the jury finds Lilly breached the terminated rezpegaldesleukin collaboration. Lilly executives, including one whose handwritten meeting note described Nektar as 'desperate,' have countered that Nektar was not harmed by the deal's 2023 termination.

news.headline: BTIG Raises Nektar Therapeutics Price Target to $178, Reiterates Buy
news.summary: BTIG restated its Buy rating and lifted its price target to $178 from $151, citing growing confidence in rezpegaldesleukin's alopecia areata trial data ahead of the Q4 2026 REZOLVE-AA off-treatment readout and the 2027 Phase 3 start. The call adds to a widening analyst split, with targets across coverage now ranging roughly from $65 to $192.

news.headline: Zacks Research Raises Q3 2026 Earnings Outlook for Nektar Therapeutics
news.summary: Zacks Research now projects a narrower Q3 2026 loss of roughly $2.45 per share for Nektar, an improvement versus the $2.85 per-share loss the company posted in the year-ago quarter. The revision comes as the stock's next scheduled earnings print is due in November.

news.headline: Nektar Announces Publication in The Lancet of Positive Phase 2b REZOLVE-AD Results for Rezpegaldesleukin in Atopic Dermatitis
news.summary: The Lancet published the full 16-week induction dataset from the 393-patient REZOLVE-AD Phase 2b study across 107 sites in 10 countries: mean EASI reductions of 61%, 58% and 53% across dose arms versus 31% for placebo (p<0.0001), with EASI-75 at 42% versus 17% and significant separation as early as Week 2. Serious adverse events occurred in only 2% of participants with no deaths and no infection or conjunctivitis signal, the first peer-reviewed validation of the Treg-expansion mechanism in a clinically meaningful skin endpoint.

news.headline: JPMorgan Initiates Coverage on Nektar Therapeutics with Neutral Rating and $65 Price Target
news.summary: JPMorgan started NKTR at Neutral with a $65 target, a second cautious voice after Wedbush's $80 (cut from $95 in May on first-line adoption concerns versus Dupixent and future biosimilars). Both sit well below Piper Sandler's Overweight rating and $192 target, illustrating a wide analyst split ahead of the mid-2028 Phase 3 readout.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: Cash and investments stood at $1,023.4 million on June 30, 2026 versus $245.8 million at year-end 2025, helped by a $373.8 million April equity raise, extending runway into Q3 2028 and past the targeted mid-2028 ZENITH AD readout. Net loss was $40.6 million ($1.23 per share) on revenue of $10.1 million, and management reaffirmed a ZENITH AD-3 start in September, a new autoimmune-indication study before year-end 2026, a Phase 3 alopecia areata start in early 2027, and a first rezpegaldesleukin BLA in 2029.

catalysts.label: Nektar v. Eli Lilly jury trial (N.D. Cal., San Francisco)
catalysts.detail: Trial opened September 8, 2026 before an 8-person jury and remained in the testimony phase as of September 10-15, with Nektar's damages expert telling jurors Lilly could owe nearly $1 billion and Lilly countering that Nektar's own financial condition (allowed in for impeachment after CEO testimony) shows no harm. No verdict has been reported yet; a decision could land within the next one to two weeks. This remains a binary, clinically-uncorrelated financial wildcard for the stock.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD-3 initiation (biologic/JAK-experienced patients)
catalysts.detail: The third roughly 510-patient Phase 3 study, enrolling atopic dermatitis patients with prior systemic biologic and/or JAK inhibitor experience, is guided to begin by late September 2026 after the July starts of ZENITH AD-1 and AD-2. It completes the roughly 1,530-patient registrational package for U.S. and European filings and tests rezpeg in patients who already failed Dupixent or a JAK. Management reaffirmed the September timing on the August 13 Q2 call; no separate start announcement has been issued yet as of mid-September.

catalysts.label: Two oral presentations at the 35th EADV Congress, Vienna
catalysts.detail: Nektar has two accepted oral presentations at EADV 2026: Thomas Bieber on durable, deepening improvements with monthly and quarterly maintenance dosing from REZOLVE-AD, and David Rosmarin (abstract AS-1872, Oct 1, 16:30-16:40 CEST) on 52-week Phase 2b REZOLVE-AA results in severe-to-very-severe alopecia areata. Maintenance durability at reduced dosing frequency is the main commercial differentiator versus Dupixent, so dermatology-community reception matters as much as the topline numbers.

catalysts.label: 24-week off-treatment alopecia areata topline (REZOLVE-AA)
catalysts.detail: Nektar has entered a quiet period ahead of releasing the 24-week off-treatment follow-up data from the 92-patient severe-to-very-severe alopecia areata Phase 2b study, guided for Q4 2026, to inform long-term maintenance dosing ahead of the Phase 3 start. Durability off drug is the key differentiator versus chronically dosed JAK inhibitors like Litfulo and Olumiant, and a September 9 BTIG price-target raise already reflects growing analyst confidence in the readout. Exact date and venue have not been named.

catalysts.label: Start of a clinical study in an additional autoimmune indication
catalysts.detail: Management committed on the Q2 call to initiating a new clinical study in a further autoimmune indication before year-end 2026, to broaden the Treg mechanism beyond atopic dermatitis, alopecia areata and type 1 diabetes. The indication has not been disclosed; a February 2026 research collaboration with UCSF (Dr. Stephen Hauser) in multiple sclerosis is the most-cited speculation.

catalysts.label: First NKTR-0165 (TNFR2 agonist) preclinical data at a scientific conference
catalysts.detail: Management has guided to presenting preclinical data for NKTR-0165, its bivalent TNFR2 agonist antibody, at a scientific conference in the second half of 2026. It is the most meaningful pipeline asset behind rezpeg and is paired with the February 2026 UCSF multiple sclerosis collaboration. Venue and date are not yet named, so slippage into 2027 is possible.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: The next quarterly report should update cash burn against full-year R&D guidance of $210-230 million, confirm the ZENITH AD-3 start with enrollment color across all three Phase 3 AD studies, and address the financial and strategic consequences of the ongoing Eli Lilly jury trial. Zacks currently projects a Q3 loss near $2.45 per share, narrower than the year-ago quarter. Exact date not yet announced; Nektar has reported Q3 in early-to-mid November in prior years.

catalysts.label: 52-week off-treatment atopic dermatitis data
catalysts.detail: Management guided to present 52-week off-treatment data for atopic dermatitis in Q1 2027 to further inform long-term maintenance dosing while the ZENITH AD Phase 3s enroll, building on earlier signals of roughly nine months of off-treatment durability.

catalysts.label: Phase 3 alopecia areata study start (~850 patients)
catalysts.detail: Management reaffirmed on the Q2 call that it will start a single registrational Phase 3 in severe alopecia areata in early 2027, sized at roughly 850 patients, based on the Phase 2b REZOLVE-AA proof-of-concept (28.2% mean SALT reduction vs 11.2% placebo at 36 weeks). Rezpeg holds FDA Fast Track in this indication; readout guided to second-half 2029.

catalysts.label: Initial Phase 2 type 1 diabetes data (TrialNet collaboration)
catalysts.detail: Nektar guided to initial 2027 data from the TrialNet-run Phase 2 randomized, placebo-controlled study of rezpegaldesleukin in roughly 70 adults and children with new-onset stage 3 type 1 diabetes. Nektar supplies drug and TrialNet funds and runs the trial, so cost to Nektar is minimal while optionality is large.

catalysts.label: First ZENITH AD Phase 3 topline readout (mid-2028)
catalysts.detail: Initial registrational efficacy data for rezpeg in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis is the decisive binary event for the equity. Cash runway extends into Q3 2028, so the company reaches this readout without needing another raise. Replicating the Phase 2b 61%-vs-31% mean EASI delta at Phase 3 scale is essentially what the bullish end of the analyst range discounts.

catalysts.label: First rezpegaldesleukin BLA submission (atopic dermatitis)
catalysts.detail: Nektar has guided to a first BLA filing for rezpegaldesleukin in atopic dermatitis in 2029 following the mid-2028 ZENITH AD topline. The Phase 3 program was designed with EMA scientific advice in parallel, so a European marketing authorisation application is intended off the same dataset.

pulse: Shares have slipped from the mid-$70s into the high-$50s/near-$60 range as September wears on, with the tape driven almost entirely by legal-event positioning rather than fresh clinical news: the Nektar v. Eli Lilly breach-of-contract jury trial in San Francisco is in its second week of testimony, with Nektar's damages expert telling jurors Lilly could owe close to $1 billion over the terminated rezpeg collaboration, while Lilly disputes any harm. Away from the courtroom, analysts remain split (JPMorgan Neutral at $65 versus BTIG's September 9 upgrade to $178 and Piper Sandler's $192), with sentiment resting on the peer-reviewed REZOLVE-AD Lancet data published in late August. With roughly $1 billion in cash funding runway into Q3 2028, the near-term sequence is a possible Lilly verdict, the ZENITH AD-3 Phase 3 start by late September, two EADV oral presentations in Vienna (Sept 30-Oct 3), and a Q4 alopecia off-treatment topline, ahead of the pivotal mid-2028 ZENITH AD Phase 3 readout.
